; Big World — a 16 km island with 600 m mountains, forests, and a far vista.
; The map is 4096² heights (16-bit in memory), generated on every core.
; WASD walk, mouse / arrows look, Shift run, F fly, 1-4 quality, Esc quit.
; Quality starts on "auto": it reads the GPU, then steps down if frames run slow.

Graphics3D(1280, 720)
SetWindowTitle("moonBASIC — Big World")
SetGraphicsQuality("auto")
SetCameraClsColor(132, 172, 205)
SetAmbientLight(84, 92, 104)
EnableFog(True)

; Fog sets how far you see. High and ultra draw a coarse vista out to it.
Function ViewFog()
    far# = 3500
    If GraphicsQuality() = 1 Then far = 1400
    If GraphicsQuality() = 0 Then far = 470
    SetFog(150, 178, 200, far * 0.25, far)
    Return GraphicsQuality()
End Function
lastQ = ViewFog()
HidePointer()
SetMousePosition(640, 360)
Color(255, 248, 230)

; Camera / sky / light
cam = CreateCamera()
SetCameraRange(cam, 0.3, 6000)
CreateSkyBox("default")
sun = CreateDirectionalLight()
SetLightColor(sun, 255, 226, 186)
SetLightShadow(sun, True)
EnableShadows(True)
SetTonemap "neutral"
SetExposure 1.05
SetTimeOfDay(10)
SetPlayer(cam)

; 4096 samples over 16384 m, 600 m tall. The rim sinks below the sea.
sea# = 40
hm = GenerateHeightmapPreset("island", 4096, 4096, 7)
FilterHeightmap(hm, "erode", 0.4)
ground = CreateTerrainFromHeightmap(hm, 16384, 16384, 600)
FreeHeightmap(hm)
ApplyTerrainSplat(ground)
SetTerrainGrassCoverage(ground, 0.74)
SetTerrainWaterHeight(ground, sea + 0.7)
SetTerrainSnow(True, 520)

; Sea — follows the camera out to the horizon
water = CreateWater(16384, 16384, 64)
SetWaterLevel(sea)
SetWaterStyle("ocean")
SetWaterColor(10, 66, 92)
SetWaterWaves(4, 0.35)
SetWaterWind(0.8, 0.3, 0.5)
EnableWaterReflection(True)
EnableWaterRefraction(True)

; 3D trees. An untextured template is planted as real meshes; its child
; meshes come along with their own colors. Hide() keeps the template itself
; out of the scene.
pine = CreateCylinder(0.2, 3, 5, 0).Color(92, 64, 42).Hide()
pineLow = CreateCone(1.9, 4.2, 6, 1, pine).Position(0, 3, 0).Color(34, 92, 46)
pineTop = CreateCone(1.35, 3.2, 6, 1, pine).Position(0, 5.2, 0).Color(40, 104, 52)

oak = CreateCylinder(0.28, 3.4, 5, 0).Color(104, 76, 52).Hide()
oakCrown = CreateSphere(4, oak).Scale(2.5, 2.1, 2.5).Position(0, 3.6, 0).Color(64, 118, 46)

TerrainTrees(ground, pine, 0.3)
TerrainTrees(ground, oak, 0.14)

rock = CreateSphere(4).Scale(1.1, 0.6, 0.9).Color(122, 116, 108).Hide()
TerrainProps(ground, rock, 0.3)

; Spawn on the south beach: walk in from the sea until the sand.
sx# = 0
sz# = 7900
While sz > -7900 And TerrainHeight(sx, sz) < sea + 0.8
    sz = sz - 4
Wend
sz = sz - 6

yaw# = 180
pitch# = 2
fly = 0
frames = 0
fpsAvg# = 60
cam.Position(sx, TerrainHeight(sx, sz) + 1.75, sz)
cam.Rotate(pitch, yaw, 0)

; Loop
While 1
    frames = frames + 1
    dt# = Time.Delta()
    yaw = yaw + MouseDeltaX() * 0.14
    pitch = pitch - MouseDeltaY() * 0.14
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_LEFT) Then yaw = yaw - 80 * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) Then yaw = yaw + 80 * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_UP) Then pitch = pitch + 50 * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_DOWN) Then pitch = pitch - 50 * dt
    If pitch > 80 Then pitch = 80
    If pitch < -80 Then pitch = -80
    cam.Rotate(pitch, yaw, 0)
    SetMousePosition(640, 360)

    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_F) Then fly = 1 - fly
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_1) Then SetGraphicsQuality("low")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_2) Then SetGraphicsQuality("medium")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_3) Then SetGraphicsQuality("high")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_4) Then SetGraphicsQuality("ultra")

    spd# = 6
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_LSHIFT) Then spd = 18
    If fly = 1 Then spd = spd * 12
    spd = spd * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_W) Then cam.Move(0, 0, spd)
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_S) Then cam.Move(0, 0, -spd)
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_A) Then cam.Move(-spd, 0, 0)
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_D) Then cam.Move(spd, 0, 0)

    ; Stay on the land or the water, whichever is higher
    h# = TerrainHeight(EntityX(cam), EntityZ(cam))
    If h < sea Then h = sea
    If fly = 0 Then
        cam.Position(EntityX(cam), h + 1.75, EntityZ(cam))
    ElseIf EntityY(cam) < h + 2 Then
        cam.Position(EntityX(cam), h + 2, EntityZ(cam))
    EndIf
    SetStreamOrigin(EntityX(cam), 0, EntityZ(cam))

    If GraphicsQuality() <> lastQ Then lastQ = ViewFog()
    fpsAvg = fpsAvg * 0.95 + StatsFPS() * 0.05
    q$ = "high"
    If GraphicsQuality() = 0 Then q$ = "low"
    If GraphicsQuality() = 1 Then q$ = "medium"
    If GraphicsQuality() = 3 Then q$ = "ultra"
    mode$ = "walk"
    If fly = 1 Then mode$ = "fly"

    Cls
    Text(12, 12, "WASD move   Shift run   F fly / walk   1-4 quality   Esc quit")
    Text(12, 32, "quality " + q$ + "   fps " + Str(Int(fpsAvg)) + "   " + mode$ + "   height " + Str(Int(h - sea)) + " m")
    RenderWorld
    Flip
    If frames > 8
        If Input.KeyHit(KEY_ESCAPE) Then End
    EndIf
Wend
End
description: Big World — a 16 km island with 600 m mountains, 3D forests, and a far vista; 16-bit heights, built on every core.
name: Big World

SetWindowTitle("moonBASIC — Modern Camera Systems")
Graphics3D(1280, 720, 0, 2)
SetBuffer(BackBuffer())
SetCameraClsColor(40, 50, 65)
SetAmbientLight(60, 70, 80)

; Camera
cam = CreateCamera()
SetCameraRange(cam, 0.1, 1000)

; Sun + shadows

SetLightDirection(sun, 50, 35, 0)
SetLightColor(sun, 255, 235, 200)

EnableShadows(True)

; Scene
ground = CreateCube().Scale(60, 0.25, 60).Position([0, 0, 0]).Color(50, 80, 60)
CreateRigidBodyBox(ground, 60, 0.25, 60, 0)

target = CreateCube().Scale(1.5, 1.5, 1.5).Position([0, 1.5, 0]).Color(220, 80, 60)

camMode = 1
orbitYaw# = 0.0
rtsX# = 0.0
rtsZ# = 0.0
rtsZoom# = 20.0

frames = 0
While 1
    frames = frames + 1
    If frames > 8 And Input.KeyHit(KEY_ESCAPE) Then Exit
    dt# = Time.Delta()

    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_1) Then camMode = 1
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_2) Then camMode = 2
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_3) Then camMode = 3
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_SPACE) Then AddCameraShake(0.6)

    ; Move target
    tx# = EntityX(target) + GetAxis(KEY_A, KEY_D) * 12.0 * dt
    tz# = EntityZ(target) + GetAxis(KEY_S, KEY_W) * 12.0 * dt
    Entity.SetPos(target, tx, 1.5, tz)

    If camMode = 1 Then
        ; Mode 1: spring-arm follow
        CameraSpringArm(cam, target, 1.5, 8.0, 0.3, 12.0, 0, 20)
    ElseIf camMode = 2 Then
        ; Mode 2: orbital
        orbitYaw = orbitYaw + 45.0 * dt
        CameraOrbit(cam, target, 12.0, 3.5, orbitYaw, 25.0)
    ElseIf camMode = 3 Then
        ; Mode 3: strategy / RTS
        rtsX = tx
        rtsZ = tz
        CameraRTS(cam, rtsX, rtsZ, rtsZoom, 55.0, 0)
    EndIf

    UpdateCameraShake(cam)

    Cls
    UpdateWorld
    RenderWorld

    Text(20, 20, "Modern Camera Systems Showcase")
    Text(20, 44, "1: Spring-Arm Anti-Clip | 2: Smooth Orbit | 3: RTS Strategy | Space: Trigger Camera Shake | Esc: Quit")
    modeName$ = "Spring-Arm"
    If camMode = 2 Then modeName$ = "Smooth Orbit"
    If camMode = 3 Then modeName$ = "RTS Strategy"
    Text(20, 68, "Current Mode: " + modeName$ + " | WASD: Move Red Target")
    Flip
Wend

; City — a 1.6 km grid of about 9000 buildings, merged into a few hundred draws.
; WASD fly, mouse / arrows look, Shift fast, Esc quit.
; MergeLevel bakes every static mesh under a root into one mesh per material
; per 64 m cell. LoadLevel(path$) does the same to a glTF / OBJ / FBX file.

Graphics3D(1280, 720)
SetWindowTitle("moonBASIC — City")
SetGraphicsQuality("auto")
SetCameraClsColor(150, 176, 205)
SetAmbientLight(90, 96, 108)
EnableFog(True)
SetFog(160, 180, 205, 300, 1400)
HidePointer()
SetMousePosition(640, 360)
Color(255, 248, 230)

cam = CreateCamera()
SetCameraRange(cam, 0.3, 3000)
CreateSkyBox("default")
sun = CreateDirectionalLight()
SetLightColor(sun, 255, 236, 210)
SetLightShadow(sun, True)
EnableShadows(True)
SetTimeOfDay(15)

; Asphalt everywhere; each block sits on a pale pavement slab
ground = CreatePlane(1800, 1800).Color(52, 55, 60)

; Buildings: every object is its own mesh until MergeLevel. Colors vary
; freely; a merged cell keeps them per vertex.
city = CreatePivot()
SeedRnd(11)
blocks = 0
For bz = -24 To 24
    For bx = -24 To 24
        cx# = bx * 32
        cz# = bz * 32
        slab = CreateCube().Scale(12.5, 0.12, 12.5).Position(cx, 0.12, cz).Color(150, 148, 142)
        EntityParent(slab, city)
        downtown = 0
        If Abs(bx) < 6 And Abs(bz) < 6 Then downtown = 1
        ; A park now and then outside downtown
        If downtown = 1 Or Rnd(0, 1) > 0.1 Then
            ; Four 12 m lots per block
            For lz = 0 To 1
                For lx = 0 To 1
                    w# = Rnd(9, 11.5)
                    d# = Rnd(9, 11.5)
                    h# = Rnd(7, 24)
                    If downtown = 1 Then h = Rnd(24, 120) * (1.2 - (Abs(bx) + Abs(bz)) / 14)
                    If h < 7 Then h = 7
                    kind = Int(Rnd(0, 4))
                    If kind = 0 Then
                        r = Rnd(150, 175)
                        g = Rnd(80, 95)
                        b = Rnd(64, 78)
                    ElseIf kind = 1 Then
                        r = Rnd(176, 200)
                        g = r - 4
                        b = r - 10
                    ElseIf kind = 2 Then
                        r = Rnd(196, 222)
                        g = r - 18
                        b = r - 46
                    Else
                        r = Rnd(92, 116)
                        g = r + 26
                        b = r + 52
                    EndIf
                    x# = cx + lx * 13 - 6.5
                    z# = cz + lz * 13 - 6.5
                    bld = CreateCube().Scale(w / 2, h / 2, d / 2).Position(x, h / 2 + 0.24, z).Color(r, g, b)
                    EntityParent(bld, city)
                    roof = CreateCube().Scale(w / 2 - 0.5, 0.35, d / 2 - 0.5).Position(x, h + 0.55, z).Color(66, 68, 74)
                    EntityParent(roof, city)
                    blocks = blocks + 1
                Next
            Next
        Else
            park = CreateCube().Scale(12, 0.2, 12).Position(cx, 0.3, cz).Color(70, 120, 58)
            EntityParent(park, city)
        EndIf
    Next
Next

; Merge: about 22000 meshes into a few hundred cell draws
draws = MergeLevel(city, 64)

yaw# = 30
pitch# = 12
cam.Position(-600, 90, -600)
cam.Rotate(pitch, yaw, 0)
frames = 0
fpsAvg# = 60

While 1
    frames = frames + 1
    dt# = Time.Delta()
    yaw = yaw + MouseDeltaX() * 0.14

sz# = 1900

    sz = sz - 4
Wend
sz = sz - 6

yaw# = 180
pitch# = 2
fly = 0
frames = 0
fpsAvg# = 60
cam.Position(sx, TerrainHeight(sx, sz) + 1.75, sz)
cam.Rotate(pitch, yaw, 0)

; Loop
While 1
    frames = frames + 1
    dt# = Time.Delta()
    yaw = yaw + MouseDeltaX() * 0.14
    pitch = pitch - MouseDeltaY() * 0.14

    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) Then yaw = yaw + 80 * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_UP) Then pitch = pitch + 50 * dt

    SetMousePosition(640, 360)

    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_2) Then SetGraphicsQuality("medium")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_3) Then SetGraphicsQuality("high")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_4) Then SetGraphicsQuality("ultra")

    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_S) Then cam.Move(0, 0, -spd)
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_A) Then cam.Move(-spd, 0, 0)
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_D) Then cam.Move(spd, 0, 0)

    If h < sea Then h = sea
    If fly = 0 Then
        cam.Position(EntityX(cam), h + 1.75, EntityZ(cam))
    ElseIf EntityY(cam) < h + 2 Then
        cam.Position(EntityX(cam), h + 2, EntityZ(cam))
    EndIf
    SetStreamOrigin(EntityX(cam), 0, EntityZ(cam))

    fpsAvg = fpsAvg * 0.95 + StatsFPS() * 0.05
    q$ = "high"
    If GraphicsQuality() = 0 Then q$ = "low"
    If GraphicsQuality() = 1 Then q$ = "medium"
    If GraphicsQuality() = 3 Then q$ = "ultra"
    mode$ = "walk"
    If fly = 1 Then mode$ = "fly"

    Cls
    Text(12, 12, "WASD move   Shift run   F fly / walk   1-4 quality   Esc quit")
    Text(12, 32, "quality " + q$ + "   fps " + Str(Int(fpsAvg)) + "   " + mode$ + "   height " + Str(Int(h - sea)) + " m")
    RenderWorld
    Flip
    If frames > 8
        If Input.KeyHit(KEY_ESCAPE) Then End
    EndIf
Wend
End

; vehicle

bars = CreateCube(jetski).Scale(0.48, 0.035, 0.035).Position([0, 0.98, 0.30]).Color(28, 30, 34)

; Simple rider silhouette, leaning visually with the steering input.

helmet = CreateSphere(10, rider).Scale(0.205, 0.14, 0.205).Position([0, 1.24, 0.04]).Color(244, 238, 224)
armL = CreateCube(rider).Scale(0.055, 0.055, 0.40).Position([-0.24, 0.70, 0.40]).Rotate(-22, 9, 0).Color(255, 194, 142)
armR = CreateCube(rider).Scale(0.055, 0.055, 0.40).Position([0.24, 0.70, 0.40]).Rotate(-22, -9, 0).Color(255, 194, 142)

; White stern spray. Its rate follows speed.

spray.Position([0, -0.18, -1.48])
SetEmitterRate(spray, 0)
SetEmitterMax(spray, 90)
SetEmitterLife(spray, 0.55)
SetEmitterSpeed(spray, 4.2)
SetEmitterSize(spray, 0.10, 0.38)
SetEmitterColor(spray, 225, 244, 255, 0.82, 190, 226, 246, 0)
SetEmitterVelocity(spray, 0, 1.5, -3.8)
SetEmitterCone(spray, 30)
SetEmitterGravity(spray, 0, -5.5, 0)

CreateJetSkiController(jetski, 0.60, 0.35, 1.55, 380)
SetCCD(jetski, True)

; loop
camYaw# = 0
camPitch# = 13
steerSmooth# = 0
frames = 0

While 1
    frames = frames + 1
    If frames > 8 And Input.KeyHit(KEY_ESCAPE) Then Exit
    dt# = Time.Delta()
    If dt <= 0 Then dt = 0.016
    If dt > 0.05 Then dt = 0.05

    camYaw = camYaw + MouseDeltaX() * 0.15
    camPitch = camPitch + MouseDeltaY() * 0.11
    If camPitch < -4 Then camPitch = -4
    If camPitch > 34 Then camPitch = 34
    MoveMouse(640, 360)

    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_S) Or Input.KeyDown(KEY_DOWN) Then throttle = -0.42

    UpdateWorld

    Text(20, 18, "JETSKI")

camPitch# = 12
coins = 0
grounded = 1
player.Position([px, py, pz])
cam.Position([px, py + 4.2, pz - 8])

Function AngWrap#(a#)
    While a > 180
        a = a - 360
    Wend
    While a < -180
        a = a + 360
    Wend
    Return a
End Function

frames = 0
While 1
    frames = frames + 1
    If frames > 8 And Input.KeyHit(KEY_ESCAPE) Then Exit
    dt# = Time.Delta()
    If dt <= 0 Then dt = 0.016
    If dt > 0.05 Then dt = 0.05

    camYaw = camYaw + MouseDeltaX() * 0.18
    camPitch = camPitch + MouseDeltaY() * 0.14
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_LEFT) Then camYaw = camYaw - 90 * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) Then camYaw = camYaw + 90 * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_UP) Then camPitch = camPitch - 70 * dt
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_DOWN) Then camPitch = camPitch + 70 * dt
    If camPitch > 48 Then camPitch = 48
    If camPitch < -18 Then camPitch = -18
    MoveMouse(640, 360)

    wishX# = 0
    wishZ# = 0
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_W) Then
        wishX = wishX + Math.Sin(camYaw)
        wishZ = wishZ + Math.Cos(camYaw)
    EndIf
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_S) Then
        wishX = wishX - Math.Sin(camYaw)
        wishZ = wishZ - Math.Cos(camYaw)
    EndIf
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_A) Then
        wishX = wishX + Math.Sin(camYaw - 90)
        wishZ = wishZ + Math.Cos(camYaw - 90)
    EndIf
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_D) Then
        wishX = wishX + Math.Sin(camYaw + 90)
        wishZ = wishZ + Math.Cos(camYaw + 90)
    EndIf
    wishLen# = Math.Sqr(wishX * wishX + wishZ * wishZ)
    If wishLen > 0.001 Then
        wishX = wishX / wishLen
        wishZ = wishZ / wishLen
    EndIf

    maxSpd# = 8.4
    If grounded Then
        fric# = 16
        acc# = 42
    Else
        fric# = 1.1
        acc# = 11
    EndIf
    spd# = Math.Sqr(vx * vx + vz * vz)
    If spd > 0.001 Then
        drop# = fric * dt
        nspd# = spd - drop
        If nspd < 0 Then nspd = 0
        vx = vx * (nspd / spd)
        vz = vz * (nspd / spd)
    EndIf
    If wishLen > 0.001 Then
        vx = vx + wishX * acc * dt
        vz = vz + wishZ * acc * dt
        hsp# = Math.Sqr(vx * vx + vz * vz)
        cap# = maxSpd
        If grounded = 0 And hsp > maxSpd Then cap = hsp
        If grounded And hsp > maxSpd Then
            vx = vx * (maxSpd / hsp)
            vz = vz * (maxSpd / hsp)
        ElseIf grounded = 0 And hsp > cap Then
            vx = vx * (cap / hsp)
            vz = vz * (cap / hsp)
        EndIf
    EndIf

    px = px + vx * dt
    pz = pz + vz * dt

    faceSpd# = Math.Sqr(vx * vx + vz * vz)
    If faceSpd > 0.45 Then
        want# = Math.ATan2(vx, vz)
        diff# = AngWrap(want - yaw)
        turn# = 640 * dt
        If grounded = 0 Then turn = 150 * dt
        If Math.Abs(diff) <= turn Then
            yaw = want
        ElseIf diff > 0 Then
            yaw = yaw + turn
        Else
            yaw = yaw - turn
        EndIf
    EndIf

    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_1) Then SetWeather("clear")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_2) Then SetWeather("rain")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_3) Then SetWeather("snow")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_4) Then SetWeather("fog")
    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_5) Then SetWeather("storm")

    If Input.KeyHit(KEY_SPACE) And grounded Then vy = 11.2
    If grounded = 0 And Input.KeyDown(KEY_SPACE) = 0 And vy > 2 Then vy = vy - 18 * dt
    grav# = 30
    If vy < 0 Then grav = 38
    vy = vy - grav * dt
    py = py + vy * dt

    grounded = 0
    best# = -999
    For i = 1 To nPad
        If Math.Abs(px - padX(i)) < padW(i) And Math.Abs(pz - padZ(i)) < padD(i) Then
            top# = padY(i)
            If py <= top + 0.45 And py >= top - 0.85 And vy <= 0.35 Then
                If top > best Then best = top
            EndIf
        EndIf
    Next
    If best > -900 Then
        py = best
        vy = 0
        grounded = 1
    EndIf
    If py < -8 Then
        px = 0 : py = 0.5 : pz = -4 : vy = 0 : vx = 0 : vz = 0
    EndIf

    Entity.SetPos(player, px, py, pz)
    SetRotation(player, 0, yaw, 0)

    bobT# = Time.MilliSecs() * 0.004
    For i = 1 To 8
        If coinOn(i) Then
            bob# = Math.Sin(bobT * 57.3 + i * 40) * 0.16
            Entity.SetPos(coinE(i), coinX(i), coinY(i) + bob, coinZ(i))
            TurnEntity(coinE(i), 0, 140 * dt, 0)
            If Dist(px, pz, coinX(i), coinZ(i)) < 1.1 And Math.Abs(py + 0.8 - coinY(i)) < 1.2 Then
                If coinE(i) Then HideEntity(coinE(i))
                coinOn(i) = 0
                coins = coins + 1
                If sndCoin Then Sound.Play(sndCoin)
            EndIf
        EndIf
    Next

    CameraFollow(cam, player, 8.2, 3.05, 8.5, camYaw, camPitch)

    Cls
    UpdateWorld
    RenderWorld
    Text(20, 16, "Platform 64")
    Text(20, 42, "Coins  " + coins + " / 8     WASD move   Space jump   Mouse / arrows look   Esc quit")
    Text(20, 68, "Weather  " + Weather$() + "    1 clear  2 rain  3 snow  4 fog  5 storm")
    If coins = 8 Then Text(20, 94, "All coins! Nice run.")
    Flip
Wend

; W throttle, S reverse, A/D steer, mouse look. Esc quits.

Graphics3D(1280, 720, 0, 2)
SetWindowTitle("moonBASIC — Wave Race")
SetBuffer(BackBuffer())
SetCameraClsColor(64, 168, 232)
SetAmbientLight(110, 120, 130)
EnableShadows(False)

cam = CreateCamera()

sun = CreateDirectionalLight()
SetLightDirection(sun, 50, 30, 0)

water = CreateWater(640, 640, 96)
SetWaterStyle("ocean")
SetWaterColor(8, 110, 190)
SetWaterWaves(4, 0.85)

EnableWaterRefraction(False)

; Eight gates on an oval. Left buoy red, right buoy yellow.
Const LastGate = 7
Dim gx(LastGate)
Dim gz(LastGate)
Dim fx(LastGate)
Dim fz(LastGate)
Dim rx(LastGate)
Dim rz(LastGate)
Dim leftB(LastGate)
Dim rightB(LastGate)

For i = 0 To LastGate
    ang = i * 45
    gx(i) = Math.Sin(ang) * 70
    gz(i) = Math.Cos(ang) * 100
    fxx = Math.Cos(ang) * 70
    fzz = -Math.Sin(ang) * 100
    flen = Math.Sqr(fxx * fxx + fzz * fzz)
    If flen < 0.001 Then flen = 1
    fx(i) = fxx / flen
    fz(i) = fzz / flen
    rx(i) = fz(i)
    rz(i) = -fx(i)
    lx = gx(i) - rx(i) * 8
    lz = gz(i) - rz(i) * 8
    rxp = gx(i) + rx(i) * 8
    rzp = gz(i) + rz(i) * 8
    leftB(i) = CreateSphere(8).Scale(1.3, 1.3, 1.3).Position([lx, WaterHeight(lx, lz) + 0.8, lz])

SetRotation(jetski, 0, yaw0, 0)

seat = CreateCube(jetski).Scale(0.36, 0.14, 0.5).Position([0, 0.48, -0.5]).Color(24, 26, 32)
rider = CreatePivot(jetski).Position([0, 0.5, -0.4])
vest = CreateCylinder(8, rider).Scale(0.24, 0.42, 0.2).Position([0, 0.5, 0]).Color(20, 70, 190)
helmet = CreateSphere(8, rider).Scale(0.2, 0.16, 0.2).Position([0, 1.15, 0.02]).Color(255, 48, 40)

CreateJetSki(jetski, 0.62, 0.36, 1.6, 420)
SetCCD(jetski, True)

camYaw = 0
camPitch = 14
steerSmooth = 0
frames = 0
nextG = 0
lap = 1
score = 0
finished = 0
prevSide = -8
msg$ = "GATE 1"
msgUntil = 0
raceT = MilliSecs()

While 1
    frames = frames + 1
    If frames > 8 And Input.KeyHit(KEY_ESCAPE) Then Exit
    dt = Time.Delta()
    If dt <= 0 Then dt = 0.016
    If dt > 0.05 Then dt = 0.05

    camYaw = camYaw + MouseDeltaX() * 0.14
    camPitch = camPitch + MouseDeltaY() * 0.1
    If camPitch < 6 Then camPitch = 6
    If camPitch > 28 Then camPitch = 28
    MoveMouse(640, 360)

    throttle = 0
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_W) Or Input.KeyDown(KEY_UP) Then throttle = 1
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_S) Or Input.KeyDown(KEY_DOWN) Then throttle = -0.4
    steer = GetAxis(KEY_A, KEY_D)
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_LEFT) Then steer = -1
    If Input.KeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) Then steer = 1
    steerSmooth = Approach(steerSmooth, steer, 8 * dt)
    UpdateJetSki(jetski, throttle, steerSmooth)
    SetRotation(rider, 8, 0, -steerSmooth * 22)

    px = EntityX(jetski)
    py = EntityY(jetski)
    pz = EntityZ(jetski)
    wh = WaterHeight(px, pz)
    speed = BodyVelocity(jetski)

    If py < wh - 3 Or Math.Sqr(px * px + pz * pz) > 220 Then
        Entity.SetPos(jetski, [gx(nextG) - fx(nextG) * 14, WaterHeight(gx(nextG), gz(nextG)) + 1.3, gz(nextG) - fz(nextG) * 14])
        SetRotation(jetski, 0, Math.ATan2(fx(nextG), fz(nextG)), 0)
        SetVelocity(jetski, 0, 0, 0)
        prevSide = -8
        px = EntityX(jetski)
        pz = EntityZ(jetski)
    EndIf

    side = (px - gx(nextG)) * fx(nextG) + (pz - gz(nextG)) * fz(nextG)
    lat = (px - gx(nextG)) * rx(nextG) + (pz - gz(nextG)) * rz(nextG)
    If finished = 0 And prevSide < 0 And side >= 0 And side < 14 Then
        If Math.Abs(lat) < 9 Then
            score = score + 100
            msg$ = "CLEAR"
            If Math.Abs(lat) < 3 Then
                score = score + 50
                msg$ = "PERFECT"
            EndIf
            nextG = nextG + 1
            If nextG > LastGate Then
                nextG = 0
                lap = lap + 1
                If lap > 3 Then
                    finished = 1
                    msg$ = "FINISH"
                EndIf
            EndIf
            msgUntil = MilliSecs() + 1000
            prevSide = -8
        ElseIf Math.Abs(lat) < 16 Then
            msg$ = "MISS"
            msgUntil = MilliSecs() + 800
            prevSide = side
        Else
            prevSide = side
        EndIf
    Else
        prevSide = side
    EndIf

    For i = 0 To LastGate
        If i = nextG And finished = 0 Then
            EntityColor(leftB(i), 255, 255, 255)
            EntityColor(rightB(i), 255, 255, 255)
        Else
            EntityColor(leftB(i), 230, 40, 36)
            EntityColor(rightB(i), 255, 210, 40)
        EndIf
    Next

    CameraFollow(cam, jetski, 9, 2.6, 12, EntityYaw(jetski) + camYaw, camPitch)

    secs = (MilliSecs() - raceT) / 1000
    Cls
    UpdateWorld
    RenderWorld
    Color(8, 24, 48, 190)
    Rect(16, 12, 460, 78, 1)
    Color(255, 220, 60)
    Text(28, 20, "WAVE RACE")
    Color(240, 246, 252)
    Text(28, 44, "Lap " + Str(lap) + " / 3    Gate " + Str(nextG + 1) + " / 8    " + Str(Int(secs)) + "s")
    Text(28, 66, "Score " + Str(score) + "    " + Str(Int(speed * 1.94)) + " knots")
    If MilliSecs() < msgUntil Then
        Color(255, 244, 140)
        Text(520, 80, msg$)
    EndIf
    Color(230, 236, 242)
    Text(28, 680, "W throttle   A/D steer   mouse look   pass the white pair   Esc quit")
    Flip
Wend
End
